review.implementation_delta: Two private controls now derive parent-specific Rule edge visits, require every selected Rule edge visited and retain counts in immutable controls. Probes omit those expected counts. Existing full ordered native trace equality checks remain unchanged.
review.counterexample: Both source fixtures visit every Rule selector but short-circuit one nested call, reaching that callee elsewhere. Before fix both incorrectly ready; after fix each whole affected family is not_evaluable.
review.positive_validation: Ready-row edge IDs equal independently selected provider/Rule import edges; every count is positive and sum equals expected call count. Wrapper forwarding is excluded from Rule visit counters.
review.source_custody_definition_correction: State Machine definition previously copied Policy closure wording. Corrected to State Machine and Rule closure; Event identifiers are not loaded. No implementation behavioral change.
